description.value: Madhouse Pizza is a family-owned, independent pizzeria in Tsawwassen founded by long-time South Delta residents Missy and Dave. They are known for an all-inclusive unlimited-topping model — no upcharges for customization — with dough and sauces made fresh daily using locally sourced ingredients. Cyclists passing through the Tsawwassen or Ladner area can order online for quick pickup or doorstep delivery.
